description: This file defines a priority queue data structure with associated operations such as insertion, deletion, and extraction of minimum, including internal data structures and function prototypes.

methods.name: pqNewPriorityQ
methods.description: Creates a new priority queue with specified size and comparison function.

methods.name: pqDeletePriorityQ
methods.description: Deletes a priority queue and frees associated resources.

methods.name: pqInit
methods.description: Initializes the priority queue before use.

methods.name: pqInsert
methods.description: Inserts a new key into the priority queue.

methods.name: pqExtractMin
methods.description: Extracts and returns the minimum key from the priority queue.

methods.name: pqDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specific handle from the priority queue.

methods.name: pqMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum key without removing it.

methods.name: pqIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the priority queue is empty.
